name: Evelyn Gupta
life: “I still remember a care calendar too small for the journeys between visits.” Sunday often includes a stop at the market by Market Flats, where Evelyn often waits until the delivery baskets are stacked before going in.
voice: I made a rota that divided time equally and forgot my brother's bus takes an hour each way.
appearance: Evelyn has a smooth side part with one rebellious curl, heavy brows and an unusually delicate jaw, and a favorite piece of clothing, a brown corduroy jacket. It usually goes with a stitched row of blue crosses along an old repair. When somebody else has the floor, Evelyn takes off the watch before a long conversation.
personality: Evelyn takes a rejection personally for a day and analytically on the second morning. Evelyn can be generous with a rival once the first night's sleep has intervened.
agenda: To correct the rota for the real travel time.
family: Adela Ferraro is Evelyn’s first cousin once removed. Evelyn gets to change the plan. Adela offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *The second dog*, Adela says, “I turned the photographs into a spot-the-difference game so my little niece would give evidence in her own words.”
connections: Alicia Sáenz. A sibling offering help checks the proposed rota against real travel time.
